subject: extn
title: EXTN.-----SOC.RT.
description: Second diagram on page 318, paired with the TH-CONT × PER-TRS crossing above it. Where the first diagram structurally shows how the applied-redefinitions hub intercepts thrust-continuance on its way to the right-hand branches, this one shows the same suppression mechanism at the deeper level the prose names — 'the reality position (and/or affinity dynamics) underlying what a given creative participation really meant (in its vibrational and cosmic sense).' The crossing: (C)EXTN (the concept of existentialism — what alternative creativity actually is, ontologically) crossed with SOC-RT (social reality — the receiving culture's organized acceptance). EXTN is subject on the left with the subject-arrow, and SOC-RT is partner-center at the end of the main line, with no branches of its own. PART (participation) runs right from the main line; OP-SD (option spread) rises up-right from the PART line, and INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) descends from it, with AF-TD branching from INDIV-DY toward the right margin. Lower down, IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism) drops from the main line to the bottom-center; APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) branches from it to the lower-left margin, with V-SY (value system) hanging from the APP-RDEF line, and VT-ATT (vibrational attitude) branches from it to the lower-right, with OBS (observation) at the very bottom hanging from VT-ATT. Structural argument: existentialism crossed with social-reality builds its side structure from two points on the main line — participation above and isolated-focus-activism below — and APP-RDEF again sits on the subject's own chain, as in the previous diagram.
